restep.why: a conditional damage or defence perk is +15% at tier I and +30% at tier II while its condition holds: more than a sixth is seen on the next hit. A d20 term under +2 is a twentieth and goes to +2 (I) and +3 (II); the squad's one ambush roll a fight goes to +4 at II

rules.felt_bar: a per-point line is judged by its sum on the sheet (Athletics 3 is +3 Defense), never one point alone (critic-player-2 14); a perk is judged alone
rules.own_door: a sum term counts on a door's cash-out only when its item is the door's own: a perk of one of the door's three skills (acquired or Mastered), an achieved perk one of whose skills is the door's and whose text names the door's output, the door's forks and class moves (ruling 30); the one exception is a perk whose own_door term is plain-only by a ruling it names (plain_by_ruling: Iron Grip, ruling 44). Everything else (traits, boons, mods, signatures, properties, achieved and ultimate perks of no door) counts on plain hits only: its term says scope plain and the profiles it reaches (hits)
rules.one_mark: ruling 41 (@scale.stack.squad): a foe carries one mark at a time; a new mark replaces the old (a condition slot "mark"); a damage mark is worth the mark's share to the whole squad and reaches every cash-out; a to-hit or Defense mark (Footnote, Fed, Exposed, Corroded) fills the same slot. The attacker carries one gift the same way (slot "gift": a given feeling, given Edge, Benediction, the Canticle)
rules.not_marks: Read (information) and the Chaplain's judged (where interventions land) are not marks
rules.mp_restate_why: a perk's MP price is today's x this, then x mp(L) on the mp cost rule (@scale.costs.rules.mp): the pool is smaller than today's, and a price is a choice at every level
rules.no_perk_cut: no perk above the step is cut (Righteous keeps its numbers): a reward is not taken back; the marks are the one number that falls (Judgement Day and True Name), and their holders get the re-pick
rules.oil_why: a Pain Threshold point's share (@scale.hp.pt_pct), negative
